title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: OpenAI releases GPT-6.1 Terra, a cheaper computer-use model
bullets.summary: Released 26 Oct: mid-range model that reads the screen and operates apps (forms, invoices, video edits), priced at $1/M input and $5/M output tokens (half of GPT-5.6 Terra), live in ChatGPT Plus/Pro/Enterprise/Edu and Codex.
bullets.how: The Construct: cheap computer-use option to benchmark against Claude for browser/desktop jobs. PRAGMA: price-drop talking point for operator builds. Brand 9 Signs: maybe for form/invoice drudgery.

bullets.title: Anthropic publishes guidance on folding subagents back into one main agent loop
bullets.summary: Posted 22 Oct: recommends collapsing many multi-agent setups into a single loop using progressive disclosure for skills and tools, citing lower cost and latency in enterprise tests, with a migration kit built on Claude API skills.
bullets.how: The Construct: audit our multi-agent swarms for splits that add cost/latency without benefit. PRAGMA: architecture-review checklist item. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: Claude Security enters public beta with continuous scanning, an API and an MCP connector
bullets.summary: 21 Oct: Enterprise customers can scan repos continuously, auto-mark findings fixed when patches ship, use team-written threat models, and call it via API/MCP connector; eligible orgs get $25k monthly credits for two months through 31 Dec.
bullets.how: PRAGMA: security-scanning offer for Enterprise operator clients. The Construct: MCP connector could gate our agent-written code/site deploys. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic-managed) GA; Opus 5.5 Fast Mode GA
bullets.summary: 22 Oct: Google Cloud customers get the full Claude Platform feature set billed on their GCP invoice; Opus 5.5 Fast Mode is generally available at $8/$40 per 1M input/output tokens.
bullets.how: The Construct: Fast Mode is an option for latency-sensitive agent steps if cost allows. PRAGMA: procurement path for GCP-committed clients. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: Claude Duet safety post: approval controls and isolated credentials
bullets.summary: Published 23 Oct: Duet asks approval before consequential actions, screens outgoing messages for sensitive info with a classifier, and keeps passwords, cookies and sign-in tokens away from the model; preview opened 21 Oct to US Pro/Max waitlist.
bullets.how: The Construct: borrow the approval-gate and credential-isolation pattern for scheduled agents. PRAGMA: reference design for client guardrails. Brand 9 Signs: no.

praxis_lesson: Cheaper computer-use models and leaner single-loop agent designs are converging, so measure each Construct job's cost per task and collapse subagent splits that don't earn their overhead.
